items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: here's January '36 [Stew Fletcher] with Stew Fletcher, Donald McCork, Herbie Haymer, you, Dave Barbour, Pete Peterson, Bob White on drums, and Red.

ctx.x:
I guess it was before that I
had done the first thing for Mildred in the
theatre in New Jersey, where Barnet had some-
how got up with Mildred, through Red, I guess.

After that Red started this
small group with Dave Barbour and Stuie
Pletcher and Herbie Haymer, Pete Peterson.
